pages.text: $(thing)Supersymmetry$()$(br2)Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Standard Model, The Dark Sector, Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Standard Model Matrix.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the relic density of the lightest supersymmetric particle (a WIMP) from its annihilation cross-section.
